up_instructions: Applied automatically on startup — the app's normal start command runs `node scripts/migrate.js` (which shells out to `prisma migrate deploy`) before `node server.js` binds a port (see the Dockerfile CMD). To apply by hand instead: DATABASE_URL="file:$SQLITE_PATH" npx prisma migrate deploy
down_instructions: DATABASE_URL="file:$SQLITE_PATH" npx prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back 20240115103000_create_user_preferences, then drop the table: sqlite3 "$SQLITE_PATH" 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS user_preferences;'
notes: Migration lives at prisma/migrations/20240115103000_create_user_preferences/ and is expressed via prisma/schema.prisma, the way the rest of this repository's schema changes are made. It creates the 'user_preferences' table (user_id, paddle_color, ball_color, bg_color, preset_name, updated_at) in a dedicated SQLite database file, separate from the ephemeral in-memory users/scores store. Runtime reads/writes still go through better-sqlite3 directly (no generated Prisma Client is used) — see db.js and preferencesRepo.js.
